input: Take a cold water swimming class outdoors

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Cold water swimming classes range from a single taster session to multi-week structured courses — the scope changes how much commitment and preparation is needed.
The location (lake, sea, river, lido) and geographic area determines which specific classes are available and what conditions the user will face.
A target date or deadline shapes how urgently a class must be found and booked, and whether preparation time is available.
Whether this is solo or with others (friends, family, partner) affects whether group booking options are needed and influences class choice.
The user's current swimming ability determines what class level is appropriate and whether any prerequisite pool training is needed first.
Some people prioritise safety instruction and technique, others want the social or wellness experience — this shapes which type of class to look for.
Knowing whether 'done well' means completing one class, building a regular habit, or reaching a specific milestone (e.g. swimming in sub-10°C water) defines the right end goal.

gold.taskTitle: Sign up for an outdoor cold water swimming class
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to take a cold water swimming class held outdoors, which involves finding, preparing for, and completing a structured session in open cold water.

questions.title: Is this a one-off taster or a multi-week course?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a single introductory session or a structured series of lessons spread over several weeks.

questions.title: What type of outdoor water venue do you prefer?
questions.description: Identify whether the user wants to swim in a lake, sea, river, or outdoor lido, as this determines which classes are relevant.

questions.title: Do you have a target date to complete this by?
questions.description: Establish whether there is a deadline or preferred timeframe, which affects urgency of booking and preparation needed.

questions.title: Will you be attending alone or with others?
questions.description: Determine if group booking is needed or if the user is joining independently, which influences class selection.

questions.title: How confident a swimmer are you currently?
questions.description: Assess the user's existing swimming ability to match them to the right beginner, intermediate, or advanced class level.

questions.title: What do you most want to get out of the class?
questions.description: Understand whether the priority is safety and technique, the wellness or mental health benefits, the social experience, or something else.

questions.title: What would completing this task successfully look like to you?
questions.description: Define the user's personal milestone — finishing one class, swimming regularly, reaching a cold-water benchmark — to set the right end goal.
